subject: Final release transition call — owners, fallback, and SLAs
messages:
From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@stellara.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Final rollout coordination and cutover window (week of May 10)

Vanessa —

Thanks for the demo last week. We want to lock the final release transition call for the week of May 10 so we can go over the cutover plan, fallback owners, and post-cutover verification steps. Key attendees from our side will be:
- Rachel Gomez (Platform lead)
- Julian Park (Security lead)
- Procurement (to confirm billing/PO next steps)
- 2x Platform engineers (TBD)

Can you please propose 2 options (one morning PT, one late afternoon PT) and include your SE and the delivery manager who will own the cutover? We attached our latest network diagram and our go/no-go checklist for reference.

Attachments: stellara-network-diagram.pdf, release-transition-checklist.xlsx

High-level asks for the call:
- Confirm cutover owners and escalation chain
- Validate maintenance window and required downtime (if any)
- Walk through rollback/fallback policies and one-button fallback owners
- Confirm post-cutover smoke tests and acceptance criteria

Appreciate it — we are targeting a 5/15 production enablement if sign-off goes well.

—Rachel
Rachel Gomez
Platform Lead | Stellara Health
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@stellara.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@stellara.io>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination and cutover window (week of May 10)

Rachel — thanks for the context and the attachments. Marcus (SE) and Vivek (delivery lead) are on the thread so we can align on owners and tech prep. Proposed slots (PT):
- Option A: Tue May 11, 09:30–10:30 (PT) — 60 min — preferred for engineering deep-dive
- Option B: Wed May 12, 16:00–17:00 (PT) — 60 min — works if you need later availability

Agenda I suggest (30/30):
1) Introductions & high-level schedule (10m)
2) Cutover runbook review — owners + timing (20m)
3) Fallback/rollback matrix + who triggers (15m)
4) Network/infra prechecks and access plan (10m)
5) Procurement/invoicing checklist & PO timeline (5m)

Please pick a slot and confirm any additional folks from your platform team. I’ll circulate an updated calendar invite with the agenda and the release checklist attached, and we’ll add a short pre-read with the specific test scripts Marcus will run.

—Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@stellara.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination and cutover window (week of May 10)

Quick technical note — thanks for the diagram, Rachel. A few items I want on the agenda explicitly so the call doesn't stall:
- Validate VPN/VPC peering windows and temporary routes (who will create the rules?)
- Confirm service account keys + KMS access for test tokens; request that a named engineer has admin-infra access during the pre-cutover window
- We will run a 15-minute KV-cache warmup and a 10-minute load spike test during the verification window; please confirm a 30-minute maintenance buffer post-cutover for any hotfixes

I prefer Option A (Tue 09:30) so we can get the engineers on the line in the morning and still have the day for follow-ups. I’ll prepare the smoke test script and attach it to the invite.

Attachments to add to invite: redwood-smoke-tests.md (text)

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@stellara.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@stellara.io>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination and cutover window (week of May 10)

Hi all — procurement here. We will join the session but want to confirm next steps on contracting and invoice timing so there are no blockers post-cutover. Quick items from our side:
- We need a final SOW or statement with the expected go-live date (please confirm 2027-05-15 if still target)
- Can Redwood provide a billing contact + invoices to billing@stellara.io and a single consolidated invoice for the activation month?
- Any procurement-specific docs we need to sign earlier? (NDA already done)

Lauren — can you provide a short billing contact line in the invite? If you prefer, I can share our PO template ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Stellara Procurement
From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@stellara.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Final rollout coordination and cutover window (week of May 10)

Thanks — we’ll take Option A (Tue May 11, 09:30–10:30 PT). Confirmed attendees:
- Rachel Gomez (Platform lead)
- Julian Park (Security lead)
- Sofia Alvarez (Platform engineer)
- Marcus Chen (Platform engineer)
- Procurement (TBD)

Requests before the call:
1) Please add a short appendix in the invite listing named cutover owners and a single point of contact for rollback (we need a named person who can trigger fallback).
2) Marcus — appreciate the smoke test script; can you add expected pass/fail criteria and the exact AWS regions/instances you’ll hit?
3) Vanessa/Lauren — procurement billing contact and invoice cadence in the invite body.

We’ll be in the conference room B2 (video only) and will have network admin available to confirm routes if needed. See you Tuesday — I expect this call to be decisive for the 5/15 target.

—Rachel
